name: FMD2r
description: FMD2r is a Rust port of the Free Manga Downloader 2 (FMD2) with a web UI. It runs FMD2's Lua website modules to browse, track and download manga from hundreds of sites.

notes.text: The first visit opens a setup wizard. Set a password there: until one is set, the API is open to anyone who can reach port 8080.
Data and downloads live in /opt/fmd2r_data and persist across updates. Bind-mount a host folder there, or add a Save to destination in Settings, to keep manga elsewhere.
Cloudflare-protected sites need FlareSolverr: install the FlareSolverr LXC and set its URL in Settings → Connections.
